## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/zthewriter/context-for-ai/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and put this in the right folder
- [ ] American English, no em dashes, sentence-case headings
- [ ] Templates keep their guidance comment and brackets, state their audience and prerequisites, and put a lead-in before every table, list, and code block
- [ ] Vendor-neutral: no step requires a commercial product. A product is one option, with an alternative beside it, and an affiliation is disclosed.
- [ ] No unverified figures: every number links a primary source or states how it was measured.
- [ ] Links checked: every new link resolves (CI checks this too).
- [ ] No secrets, keys, tokens, real hostnames, or real customer data.
- [ ] Links and diagrams render (CI checks both)
